content:
Anna: Quick sync — weekly model prioritization. Need to pick 2 models for bring-up this sprint. Candidates: Orchid-lite-30B (fast, quant-friendly), Cerulean-70B (high quality), and Bluejay-13B-slim (low-cost).
Mike: What's our scoring rubric? Last time it was quality*0.4 + infra_risk*0.2 + cost*0.2 + demand*0.2
Raj: Agree but propose we add eval turnaround time (faster => higher priority). Suggested weights: quality 0.35, infra risk 0.15, cost 0.2, demand 0.15, turnaround 0.15
Sophia: We should also check quant-compatibility early. Orchid-lite was promising in preliminary q8_0 runs.
Anna: OK. Quick poll: which two should we prioritize? Reply with numbers: 1) Orchid-lite-30B 2) Cerulean-70B 3) Bluejay-13B-slim
Mike: 1 & 2 for me. Orchid for dedicated low-latency use-cases, Cerulean to validate quality uplift.
Raj: 1 & 3 — Bluejay for embedding lower-cost offering.
Sophia: 1 & 2. Orchid quant experiments already started, Cerulean needs eval harness though.
Anna: tally = Orchid x3, Cerulean x2, Bluejay x1. Leaning Orchid + Cerulean.
Anna: Proposed quick checklist for bring-up (short):
```
- Run baseline zero-shot eval (MMLU, ARC, PIQA)
- Run prompt set from prod-replay top 50
- Quant test: q8_0 + q4_0 where supported
- Latency/cost bench on dedicated A10x/RTX6000
- Safety/degeneration smoke tests
- Canary rollout config + fallback to tuned family
```
Sophia: I'll own the eval harness and prompt replay. ETA 3 days.
Mike: I'll do latency/cost bench on Dedicated pool and estimate qps. ETA 2 days.
Raj: I'll run quant experiments on the lab rigs and produce regression diff. ETA 2 days.
Anna: I'll draft the canary rollout plan and SLA targets. Also will add tickets to the sprint board.
quant-bot: Orchid-lite-30B q8_0 pass: 78/100 on the internal sensibility check, mem 12GB, VRAM perf good. (run 1832110000)
Sophia: Nice — can you attach sample outputs to the eval ticket when you post them?
quant-bot: Attached to ticket RL-4982
Mike: FYI, Cerulean has a known tokenizer mismatch issue on our old tokenizer pipeline — will need re-tokenization or patched tokenizer. Not a blocker but +1 infra risk.
Anna: Noted. Given votes and quick wins, locking in Orchid-lite-30B and Cerulean-70B for this sprint. I'll create an RFC with the checklist and owners.
Raj: Quick question — do we want to try q4_0 on Orchid in-parallel? It might regress quality but save cost.
Sophia: Let's do a small q4_0 smoke on the shortest eval set only, if pass we scale.
Anna: Decision: run q4_0 smoke (Raj), full q8_0 experiments (Raj), harness (Sophia), bench (Mike). I'll create tickets and @mention owners.
Mike: :thumbsup:
Sophia: :raised_hands:
Anna: Thanks team. I'll post RFC + sprint tickets in ~30m. If anything urgent ping me.
